summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an undeclared 727 KB obfuscated payload
details: The package presents itself as a Prettier configuration (main: index.js is a 20-line config object), but its package.json preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads a pinned Bun v1.3.13 runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js — a 727 KB single-line obfuscated bundle (Bun-CJS header, string-array rotator function WV8StW) that is never referenced by the declared prettier entry point. setup.mjs itself uses hex-mangled identifiers and proxy-object indirection to hide its constants and URLs. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: an alien language runtime is fetched at install time and used to execute a bundled opaque payload whose purpose is undocumented and whose contents cannot be inspected from the visible package code, evading Node-only scanning. The payload runs automatically on npm install of a package that advertises no functionality beyond a Prettier config.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
